page.overview:
Who is Zap?

Secondary: Infantry; Artillery; Combat Engineer

Zap has a reputation for maintaining his composure even under heavy fire. He has to, he works with explosives. His particular specialty involves anti-armor and anti-tank weapons and a second specialty as the demolitions man. He may have a fun-loving attitude and a keen sense of humor but Zap is one of the most professional soldiers in the Joe Team. The man is inspirational to new recruits.

Zap provided firepower support in the Burkhart rescue mission. Once Cobra has retreated and the Joe Team finds out that the enemy base is rigged to blow up, Zap finds his limited flying skills with helicopters tested once more. His expertise in demolitions came in very handy when a radical survivalist activated the timer to a bomb of nuclear nature. He worked together with Grunt in disabling it. Zap was on duty in the Fort Wadsworth motor pool when Clutch, Steeler, and Breaker arrived with a battle robot captured from Cobra in a raid.

When a survival extremist named Wingfield gets the attention of the Joe Team, Zap was called in to defuse a nuclear warhead buried under his compound. He was aided by Grunt and they successfully deactivated the bomb with seconds to spare. Zap was deployed as part of the inner ring defenses assigned to protect a space shuttle launch from Cobra. During the battle against S.E.A. Legs and Amphibious Assault Guns, Zap and Short-Fuze used their anti-armor weapons to great effect. When the Joe team assaulted Cobra's Undersea Base, Zap, Short-Fuze, and Rock 'n Roll provided cover fire with the heavy weapons.
